model: official Sony SilentCipher 44.1 kHz 73999_iteration; frozen checkpoint
candidate_order: 47 -> 45 -> 43; if 47 passes all quality and channel checks stop immediately; otherwise evaluate remaining fixed candidates, then select passing candidate by highest exported-WAV SNR, lower LSD, then higher message_sdr
mp3_protocol: P8-compatible PCM16 mono WAV at 44100 Hz -> FFmpeg libmp3lame CBR 128 kbps -> PCM float WAV
aac_protocol: reuse app.v4_audio_processing.process_channel AAC 128 kbps: native AAC-LC M4A, metadata-aware FFmpeg decode, preserve leading samples, trim only known trailing padding to source sample count
message_compare: sender-side exact-message comparison occurs only after independent detector result; blind detector receives only received samples, model, sample rate, and frozen PresencePolicy

quality_gate.note: predeclared engineering floors; LSD is not a perceptual metric and no listening test is implied

selection: among candidates meeting every channel exact+IDENTIFIED result and quality gate, maximize exported PCM16 WAV SNR; tie-break lower LSD then higher message_sdr_db
source_unit: one distinct original recording per source; two messages on each new source are repeated measures

historical_development_sources.message_source: P1 frozen historical failed MP3 case

new_source_limits: Six MUSAN source recordings are unique relative to P1/P3/P5/P6/P9 manifest SHA256s and paths. Their music files are 16 kHz, resampled once; no new native 44.1/48 kHz music source is available locally. New-source results are exploratory and source-disjoint from listed historical phases, not a large generalization study.
negative_controls: unwatermarked clean, MP3 128 kbps, AAC-LC/M4A 128 kbps for each of six new sources; detector receives no message or embedding context
